title: AI-driven repos need an explicit reading order
observation: Even after design documents are split by concern, AI implementation still risks skipping requirements boundaries unless the repository defines a fixed reading order from AGENTS to requirements, architecture, open questions, and ExecPlan.
impact: A dedicated reading-order guide reduces the chance of local design docs being read in isolation and helps future implementation stay within MVP and unresolved-boundary constraints.
candidate_rule: When a repository relies on AI-driven implementation, add an explicit reading-order guide and backlink it from AGENTS and top-level docs.
evidence: The documentation set became easier to explain only after context-loading-guide.md and AGENTS backlinks were added
Before the reading-order guide, the repo had the right documents but not a fixed path through them
